race.comment: BARBARY TALES (4) did not live up to market expectations last time out when fifth, beaten 7 metres, over 2200m at this track. A nice draw on the front line should ensure a cosy run. This looks a sterner test than last time but on her best form she is capable of a far better performance. HUNGRY HIPPO (12) was responsible for a good effort at his latest appearance to get home by a narrow margin over 2200m at this track on July 19. May just need a bit of luck at some point from this difficult draw. Meeting a deeper field this time but he has the ability to mix it with them. SNOWIEWILLREV (9) is worth another chance after a last-start seventh over 2090m at Hobart six days ago. LIKEYOUFORAREASON (1) must be included after winning his past four starts, the latest at this track two weeks ago.
